name: Balionn-Gur's planet
description: The Sith Lord Balionn-Gur conquered a planet during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic and set out to rule it through law and order rather than fear. Thus, he hired diplomats to convince the populace of his intentions.
